name: student-management-system
description: Full-stack Student Management System (React 19 + Node.js Express + PostgreSQL + Firebase Storage)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
